Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick sync on Coupa enrollment / MSA redlines

Jonas / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We're trying to finalize the vendor enrollment in Coupa but hit two items that block activation: the MSA redline around liability/timeboxed indemnity, and a mismatch between the PO fields your order form expects and Coupa's required XML.

Specifics:
- Coupa requires the "RemitTaxID" field in the PO XML rather than the generic "Tax ID" column used by your order form.
- Their PO Type field needs to be mapped to our internal PO prefix logic (we use a 3-letter prefix to route to different cost centers).

I attached our portal PO spec and a short sample payload. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept the "RemitTaxID" mapping as-is and whether legal is comfortable with the redline we saw? If helpful, we can do a 30-min triage call.

Attachments: ProcureX_PO_Specs.pdf (portal PO/XML sample)

Thanks,
Taylor Lane
Vendor Ops, ProcureX
[Attachment: ProcureX_PO_Specs.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick sync on Coupa enrollment / MSA redlines

Jonas / Kimberly — jumping in from Legal. Thanks for flagging. I looked through ProcureX's redline (sent during the demo) and made targeted edits — the main open items are:

1) Section 7 (Liability cap): ProcureX wants to change the cap from 2x fees (standard) to a fixed USD amount with a shorter lookback window. We should offer a compromise: keep the cap tied to fees but exempt liability for data loss if caused by gross negligence.

2) Section 12 (Indemnity): their language expands third-party claim scope beyond what we can accept. We can accept a narrower carve-in tied to direct misuse of our service.

3) Order Form references: ensure the Order Form explicitly maps which PO fields are considered binding for payment vs routing. I added comments in ProcureX_MSA_redline_v3.docx.

I attached my markup and included inline comments where Legal needs the procurement inputs (e.g., allowable PO prefixes, SFTP timing). Once procurement confirms the PO field list, I can draft a short counter-redline (tracked) and we can present it on the call.

Proposed message to ProcureX at triage: we accept technical field mapping pending confirmation and will present alternative legal language that preserves commercial terms.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ProcureX_MSA_redline_v3.docx (docx)]

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Quick sync on Coupa enrollment / MSA redlines — field mappings and timeline

Hi Taylor / ProcureX team — thanks for the specs. I filled the attached field map with our expected column names and mapped them to the Coupa XML fields. Summary of the important points: 

- Tax ID mapping: we will accept RemitTaxID -> remit_tax_id in our ingestion flow. Please confirm the exact character length and whether you strip non-numeric characters.
- PO Type / prefix routing: we can support a 3-letter prefix in the PONumber field (example: HLT-12345) and will route based on the prefix. Procurement must provide the list of prefixes and cost center mapping.
- PO acknowledgement (POACK): Redwood supports automated acknowledgement back to Coupa within 60 minutes of receipt for standard SKUs; for custom SOWs we will send manual ack. Please flag SOWs using the PO Type field.
- SFTP endpoint: we'll accept SFTP push; please share host/username and a test payload.

I've attached OrderForm_Coupa_FieldMap.xlsx (filled) and a short sample CSV layout that mirrors our order form.

Next steps:
1) ProcureX: confirm prefix list + SFTP test credentials.
2) Legal (Marissa): once prefix list is provided, please confirm whether any of the prefix/cost-center mappings create a contract exposure we need to call out.
3) Ops (Taylor): confirm 11/13 10:00 AM PST for the triage call.

Attachments: OrderForm_Coupa_FieldMap.xlsx

Best,
Kimberly Park
Partner Onboarding Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: OrderForm_Coupa_FieldMap.xlsx (xlsx)]
